Privacy Policy
Who Are We?
We are Showbie Inc., the provider of Socrative. Our head office is located at #436, 3428–99 Street N.W.Edmonton, AB,
Canada T6E 5X5.
Socrative is a web-based and tablet app that can be used by teachers to assess student understanding in real-time
through activities such as quizzes and polls. There are free and paid versions.
Showbie is a Data Controller with respect to Personal Data which we collect and process for our own purposes in order
to provide our products and services to customers. Showbie is a Data Processor when processing Personal Data on
behalf of our customers, for example, schools, teachers etc.
Our Privacy Pledge
Showbie Inc. (“Showbie”, “we” or “us”) provides certain services including the Socrative application (the “Application”)
and related software services as more particularly described in our Terms of Use (“Services”). Your trust is key to the
success of our business. We take privacy and confidentiality very seriously and safeguard the Personal Data of our
users in accordance with this Privacy Policy.
This Privacy Policy discusses the high degree of importance that we place on your privacy, including how we collect,
use, and disclose Personal Data as well as the rules and conditions related to privacy of information while using our
Services.
This Privacy Policy does not apply to the practices of companies that we do not own or control. Our customers are
responsible for maintaining their own privacy policies governing their collection, use, and disclosure of Personal Data
and are responsible for ensuring that they have obtained the necessary authorizations and consents for any Personal
Data made available to us for use in accordance with this Privacy Policy.
This Policy sets out the basis on which any Personal Data we collect from you, or from others, will be processed by us.
Please read the following carefully to understand our practices regarding your Personal Data and how we will treat it.
Details of Personal Data Processing
In the course of our business, we collect and process the Personal Data as set out in this Policy. This may include data
we receive directly from a Data Subject (for example, by completing forms or by corresponding with us by mail, phone,
email, or otherwise) and data we receive from other sources (including, for example, business partners, sub-contractors
in technical, payment and delivery services, credit reference agencies, government bodies, and others).
We will only process Personal Data for the specific purposes set out in this Policy or for any other purposes specifically
permitted by the applicable law. We will notify those purposes to the Data Subject when we first collect the data or as
soon as possible thereafter.
You may give us Personal Data where you are a user of our Services, a teacher, school or other third party interacting
with us. We use your Personal Data for the following purposes:
To provide and maintain our Application and Services
To notify you about changes to our Application and Services
To allow you to participate in interactive features of our Application and Services when you choose to do so
To provide customer support
To gather analysis or information so that we can improve our Application and Services
To monitor the usage of our Application and Services to detect, prevent, and address security issues

Use of AI-supported tools
We may use AI-supported tools to assist with certain limited aspects of our operations, including customer support,
internal analysis, and the improvement of our Application and Services.
Such tools may be used to summarise or analyse customer communications (such as support requests), assist in the
preparation of draft responses, and generate aggregated insights to support product development and service quality.
This processing is limited in scope and designed to minimise the use of Personal Data.
AI-supported tools are used solely for internal operational purposes and are not intended to process student Personal
Data as part of the delivery of our Services. We implement appropriate organisational and technical measures to
minimise the risk of such data being included in AI-assisted processing.
All AI-assisted outputs are subject to human review. We do not use AI systems to make solely automated decisions that
have legal or similarly significant effects on individuals.
Further details of the Personal Data we collect, details of the processing activity, and the
lawful basis for each is as follows:
When you become our customer the processing of your information, and/or that of your team who you nominate to liaise
with us, will become a condition of the contract between us as we require certain information in order to be able to
provide you with our services (e.g. contact information). In those circumstances, if you do not provide your information
when requested, we may be unable to provide our Services to you.
Representatives of customers (schools, districts, businesses, etc.):
We require the following information to set up your accounts: first name, last name, email address, phone number
(optional), country, and school name. We use this data to set you up as a customer on our systems and to liaise with you
and your teachers about projects that we are undertaking with you. We also process payment information to facilitate
payment of our Services; for internal and external auditing and to make appropriate financial returns to revenue; to
process payment of invoices etc. Our payment system also collects the IP address of users who pay online to facilitate
credit card location verification.
We collect, use and disclose your Personal Data to provide the Services to you via the Application, and to administer
your account in accordance with: (a) this Policy, (b) any other agreement you may have entered into with us, and (c)
applicable laws and regulations. It is your responsibility to ensure that we are kept informed of the correct and current
contact information for you.
The lawful basis for this processing is the agreement you have agreed to, or if you have not entered into an agreement
with us, our legitimate interests in providing the Application and Services through our agreement with the customer.
When corresponding with us by phone, e-mail or otherwise, we ask you to disclose only as much information as is
necessary to provide you with our Services or to submit a question/suggestion/comment in relation to our Services or
products.
The lawful basis for this activity is our agreement with your or our legitimate interests in providing our Application and
Services in addition to our legitimate interests in improving our Application and Services based on your
question/suggestion/comment.
If you are a Teacher/Administrator:
We collect and process your first name, last name, email address, phone number (optional), country, school name,
school type, user ID, password, activity within the service. Your first and last name will be visible to other teachers within
your team to facilitate collaboration.
If you join a Team, your email visibility will depend on your type of account. In organization-managed accounts, email
addresses are only visible to administrators by default. In individual-managed accounts, email addresses are visible to
all team members by default. Before joining a Team, users are informed that their email may be visible to other
members. Administrators in organization-managed accounts can manage email visibility settings for their teams. Email
addresses may be shared with new and existing team members and guests as part of team collaboration, as well as for
account management, support, or as otherwise specified in this Privacy Policy.

We also process payment information to facilitate payment of our Services; for internal and external auditing and to
make appropriate financial returns to revenue; to process payment of invoices etc. Our payment system also collects the
IP address of users who pay online to facilitate credit card location verification.
When corresponding with us by phone, e-mail or otherwise, we ask you to disclose only as much information as is
necessary to provide you with our Services or to submit a question/suggestion/comment in relation to our Services or
products. Users can log in to our Services directly using the Socrative app/web page or by using certain specified
third-party accounts such as Google and MasteryConnect. We may add other third-party sign-on functionality in the
future. By signing on in using a third-party account, we use your name, profile picture (if available), and email address to
authenticate your identity and to pre-populate your profile.
Some third-party services, such as Google, give you the option to post or share information about your use of the
services to your third-party account. The settings for that kind of sharing are outside of our Services. It’s up to you to
check the sharing and privacy settings on any third-party accounts.
The lawful basis for this processing is the Terms of Use you have agreed to, or our legitimate interest in facilitating the
provision of the Applications and Services to our customers, including processing payment.
If you input the Personal Data of others into the application, you are responsible for ensuring that you have obtained any
permissions or authorizations for any Personal Data of others that you input or send through the Application.
We will communicate with you regarding our Services and your account. We will do this via the internet and via the email
address you have provided. You acknowledge that data and information transmitted over the internet is susceptible to
error or security breaches.
The lawful basis for this activity is the agreement you have entered into or our legitimate interests in providing you with
important information about the Services and your account.
Showbie makes available certain AI-features which gives you the possibility to generate quiz content (quiz name,
questions, and answers), based on prompts provided by you. Any generated content must be approved by you before it
may become visible to students. These AI features are based on services from third party general purpose AI providers.
By using the features, limited personal data concerning your use of the Services and your account will be processed.
The AI features will not be used for grading student work, and only limited, anonymized student data will be processed
by using the features. The lawful basis for our provision of the AI services to you is our legitimate interest in allowing
teachers to utilize up to date features in our Services. We provide you with an option to out-out from having the AI
features made available to you in the Service, which reflects your right to object to our processing of your personal data
when the processing is based on a legitimate interest.
If you are a Student:
Showbie collects limited Personal Data from minor students only as needed for the operation and management of the
Services provided by Showbie, and only where that student’s school board, educational institution, or teacher has
contracted with Showbie to do so.
Data we collect from students:
Name, if provided by the student when prompted in an activity
Students’ activities within the service, such as quiz results
Any correspondence through phone, e-mail or otherwise for support purposes
Data that could be inferred from the teacher data:
Name when provided by the teacher in a rostered room
Email when provided by the teacher in a rostered room
Student ID when provided by the teacher in a rostered room
Log-in details (username and encrypted password) when provided by the teacher in a rostered room
School name
Location of school

Class or group membership when students are linked through Showbie integration
Limited student personal data if part of a user research interview
Teachers may upload (import) a class roster which includes unique usernames and encrypted passwords for each
student. When not importing a class rosters, teachers can provide a code for students to access the app, and creating a
student profile is not required.
Teachers will have access to class rosters and students’ activities within the service, such as quiz results.
Teachers may share template quizzes, tests, etc. with other persons using Socrative, but these templates do not contain
any Personal Data about students, only the name of the teacher author.
When corresponding with us by phone, e-mail or otherwise, we ask you to disclose only as much information as is
necessary to provide you with our Services or to submit a question/suggestion/comment in relation to our Services or
products.
(a) It is the responsibility of our customers, e.g. the school board, educational institution, or teacher to obtain the consent
of parents/legal guardians prior to our collection of such student Personal Data. If you are a minor student, do not upload
or send any Personal Data about yourself or other students to Showbie, other than what is requested upon signing up for
the Services. If we discover we have the Personal Data of a student without consent of a parent/legal guardian, or
information in excess of what we request upon sign-up, we will permanently destroy that information as quickly as
possible. If you believe a student may have provided us Personal Data without consent of a parent/legal guardian, or
information in excess of what we request upon sign-up, please contact us at privacy@socrative.com.
(b) Students can sign up to our Services with a username and password. Your teacher may instead provide you with a
code, in which case you will not be required to sign up to access Socrative. Students are unable to see the activities of
other students, irrespective of whether or not they are members of the same course group on Socrative.
(c) The Application allows students and teachers to interact. This information will also form part of the Personal Data of
students. However, we are a Data Processor of this Personal Data on behalf of the students’ school board, educational
institution or teacher who has contracted with us, and that school board, educational institution, or teacher is the Data
Controller.
d) Showbie conducts a small number of user research interviews to gather constructive feedback from the users of the
Socrative services. The feedback is used to improve and develop the services. Before conducting a user research
interview we ask for the consent from those we interview, which are mostly teachers or administrators. When conducting
the interview, some student data may be processed. This may occur as a natural part of the interview, e.g., if a teacher
shares their Socrative interface with us during the interview. Showbie will make every effort to limit the collection of
student data in interviews and the scope of the research is never targeted to student data. The incidental processing of
student data may include the following: name of the organization, geographic location, age of students, subjects taught,
extracurriculars participated in, example student work (uploaded files, annotated documents, comments), student
names, student profile pictures, student class enrollment. For the processing of student data as part of the user research
interviews, Showbie is the Data Controller.
When we act as a Data Controller for the purposes set out above, the lawful basis for the processing is the agreement
entered into with us, or our legitimate interests in providing the Application and Services through our agreement with
your school board, educational institution, teacher, or the like.
Information collected as part of our sales and marketing efforts:
We collect, use and disclose Personal Data of administrative users or teachers for marketing purposes provided it does
not direct advertising to any student users, and provided that student Personal Data is not used or disclosed. We collect
Personal Data relating to administrative users or teachers for relevant product or marketing communications. We will
never direct advertising to students or disclose student Personal Data for this purpose. Users may unsubscribe from
marketing notifications at any time.
We collect, aggregate, and anonymize data for system monitoring, quality control, marketing, and product improvement
purposes, provided it does not entail processing of any Personal Data of users.
The lawful basis for this activity is legitimate interest in selling and marketing our services when advertising to existing
customers and consent when advertising to new and potential customers.

Cookies and Analytics:
We use both session-based and persistent cookies to track information about your use of the Application and our
Services which allow us to make it easier for you to navigate the Services, or allow us to track your activities related to
your use of the Application and our Services. We may also use third party analytics tools and technologies to track and
analyze data from the Application and our Services. Read more about our use of cookies in our Cookie Policy available
here.
Access to and Transfer of Personal Data
If you are located outside Canada or the United States and choose to provide information to us, note that we transfer the
data, including Personal Data, to countries such as Canada and the United States.
All Personal Data processed by Showbie related to the Application and Services provided to our customers is stored in
secure data centres hosted by Amazon Web Services (AWS) in the United States, with backup servers in South
America, Asia and Australia. The full list of approved sub-processors, used in our capacity as a Data Processor, is listed
in the GDPR compliant Data Processing Addendum (based on the EU Commission standard contractual clauses
(2021/914)) we execute with all customers residing in the EEA.
In our capacity as a Data Controller, we rely on trusted third-party service providers such as for internal business
operations, account administration, billing, improvement of services, and marketing. In this respect, our trusted
third-party service providers may have access to relevant Personal Data in order for them to provide their services to us.
A current list of Socrative subprocessors, including information about their role and processing locations, is available
here.
Where the customer is located in the EEA and the service provider is located in a country outside the EEA (“third
country”) this will involve transferring of Personal Data to such a third country.
Transfers to Showbie Inc., located in Canada, are covered by the EU Commissions Adequacy Decision (2002/2 EC).
Showbie will not transfer Personal Data to third countries that do not offer adequate protection unless appropriate
safeguards are established, such as EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
In addition, we may disclose your Personal Data to third parties:
In the event that we sell or buy any business or assets, we may disclose your Personal Data to the prospective seller or
buyer of such business or assets;
If we, or substantially all of our assets, are acquired by a third party, information held by us about our customers will be
one of the transferred assets;
If we are under a duty to disclose or share your information in order to comply with any legal obligation, or in order to
enforce or apply our terms of use and other agreements; or to protect our rights, property, or safety, our customers, or
others. This includes exchanging information with other companies and organisations for the purposes of fraud
protection and credit risk reduction;
As part of a project with other companies in the Showbie Group.
We may also be required to disclose Personal Data in response to a lawful request by public authorities, including to
meet national security or law enforcement requirements. When acting in the role as a Data Processor we are committed
to using reasonable efforts in redirecting any access requests received from governmental authorities or to notify the
relevant customer about the request, unless we are prevented by law from doing so. In any case, we will challenge any
overbroad or inappropriate disclosure and disclose only the minimum amount of Personal Data necessary to satisfy an
access request.
How Long Do We Keep Hold of Your Information?
In our capacity as a Data Controller, the time periods for which we retain your data depends on the type of personal data
and the purposes for which we use it. We will retain and use your Personal Data to the extent necessary to provide the
Services and to comply with our legal obligations (for example, if we are required to retain your data to comply with
applicable laws), resolve disputes, and enforce our legal agreements and policies.

We will also retain usage data for internal analysis purposes. Usage data is generally retained for a shorter period of
time, except when this data is used to strengthen the security or to improve the functionality of our Services, or we are
legally obligated to retain this data for longer time periods.
Our Data Controller customers, on whose behalf we process Personal Data acting as a Data Processor, collect and
keep Personal Data. For further information on this, please contact your teacher, your school’s Socrative Administrator
or the like.
Security of Personal Data
The security of your data is important to us but no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic
storage is 100% secure. We will use appropriate technical and organizational measures to maintain the confidentiality,
integrity, and availability of your Personal Data. We have implemented a personal data breach response protocol to
promptly address any security incidents and personal data breaches that occur. This protocol includes initiating
necessary remediation measures to minimize harm and restore security. In the event of a personal data breach, we will
assess the level of risk and notify the relevant supervisory authority within 72 hours where required under applicable law.
If the breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of affected Users, they will also be notified without
undue delay. We continuously monitor and enhance our security controls to protect user data and prevent unauthorized
access.
“Do Not Track” Signals
We do not support Do Not Track (“DNT”). Do Not Track is a preference you can set in your web browser to inform
websites that you do not want to be tracked.
You can enable or disable Do Not Track by visiting the Preferences or Settings page of your web browser.
What are Your Rights with Respect to Your Personal Data?
You have the following rights:
To request access to or a copy of the Personal Data held by us relating to you (a “Data Subject Access Request”). To
make a Data Subject Access Request, please email us at privacy@socrative.com.
To request that data is rectified, corrected or erased (subject to certain statutory restrictions).
To restrict the processing of Personal Data in certain circumstances.
To object to processing of Personal Data based on public interest grounds or based on legitimate interest of the data
controller (subject to certain statutory exceptions).
To data portability, that is, to receive Personal Data about you and have it transmitted to another data controller, subject
to certain limitations.
Where your data is processed based on your consent, you have the right to withdraw your consent at any time.
However, this will not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before your consent was withdrawn.
Whenever possible, you can update your Information directly within your account settings section. If you are unable to
change your information, please contact us to make the required changes.
To avail of any of the rights set out above, you may make a request to privacy@socrative.com. For the protection of
privacy, suitable proof of identification will be required before a request can be processed.
We maintain an internal process for reviewing and responding to privacy-related complaints and concerns in accordance
with applicable data protection laws.
Where we act as Data Processor and not Data Controller, we will refer your request to the applicable Data Controller,
which, if you are a student, may be your teacher, school district, your educational institution or the like.
You also have the right to make a complaint to a supervisory authority. For a list of Supervisory Authorities in Europe,
please see this list on the European Commission’s website.
In Canada you can contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

What Will Happen if We Change Our Privacy Policy?
This Policy may change from time to time, and any changes will be posted on our website and will be effective when
posted. This Policy was last updated on July 9, 2025.
How can you contact us?
If You have questions about this Privacy Notice or wish to contact Socrative for any reason, please contact us at:
Privacy Officer Socrative, Showbie Inc. #436, 3428–99 Street N.W.Edmonton, AB, Canada T6E 5X5. Email:
privacy@socrative.com
Definitions
Personal Data
Personal Data means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person. An identifiable natural
person is one who can be identified, directly or indirectly.
Usage Data
Usage Data is data collected automatically either generated by the use of the Services or from the Service’s
infrastructure itself (for example, the duration of a page visit).
Cookies
Cookies are small pieces of data stored on a User’s device.
Data Controller
Data Controller means the natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body which, alone or jointly with
others, determines the purposes and means of the processing of the personal data.
For the purpose of this Privacy Policy, Showbie is both a Data Controller, but Showbie may in other situations act as a
Data Processor of your data.
Data Processor (or Service Providers)
Data Processor (or Service Provider) means a natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body (other than
an employee of the Data Controller) which processes Personal Data on behalf of the Data Controller.
We may use the services of various Service Providers to process your data more effectively.
Data Subject
Data Subject is a living individual who is the subject of Personal Data.
User
The User is the individual using our Application or Services. The User is typically the Data Subject, who is the subject of
Personal Data.
Personal Data Breach
A breach of security leading to the accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure of, or
access to, personal data transmitted, stored, or otherwise processed.

Terms and Conditions

using the Services. These terms replace all previous terms.
BY DOWNLOADING OR USING THE SOCRATIVE SERVICES, YOU AGREE TO BE BOUND BY THESE TERMS.

1.5 “QR Codes” are codes issued by Showbie to provide access to Student Users.

A limited use trial account (i.e. free account) permits use of the Services by individual teachers for themselves and their

of Your curriculum; You are over the age of majority; and You are entering this Agreement on behalf of Your school

2.4 Student Users. The Services are also designed for use by student users at an Educational Institution. Minor students

2.5 Other User Restrictions. If You are accessing the Services as a User, You acknowledge and agree that the content

2.6 Intellectual Property. Showbie and its third-party licensors own any and all intellectual property rights and all right,

2.7 Trial Period, Public or Beta Usage. Any free, trial, public or beta portions of the Services are still subject to these

2.8 Third-Party Content. From time to time, we may make certain third-party content available on the Website or
Application or other Services, such as educational content or lesson plans.
(a) Some third-party content may be made available as a free download or as part of a free update for non-commercial
use under Creative Commons or open-source license terms, and this type of content is not part of our chargeable
Services. We do not charge any fee for the use of such third-party content, even though You may pay separately for
other services or content from us.
(b) Other third-party content may be part of a paid download or upgrade, or made available as part of our chargeable
Services.
In both cases (chargeable and non-commercial content), this third-party content remains the property of the third-party
owners or licensors, and we do not claim to own this third-party content nor take responsibility for it. If any license terms
apply to the third-party content, we will make reasonable efforts to make those license terms (or appropriate links or

2.9 Codes. You are responsible for safekeeping any Access Codes made available to You to access the Services. You
acknowledge and agree that sharing any Access Code or password with an unauthorized third-party is strictly forbidden.
In no circumstances will Showbie be liable for any loss or damage of any kind incurred as a result of unauthorized
access to the Services caused by sharing Access Codes.
2.10 Disclaimer regarding third party beneficiaries (Apple Inc. and Google Play. Be advised that Showbie in no way is
affiliated with Apple Inc., Google Inc. or any of their respective subsidiaries (“Third-Party Beneficiary“), and that the
Services are not endorsed, administered or sponsored by such Third-Party Beneficiary.
If you download the Application or use any Services on a platform or device provided by a Third-Party Beneficiary, the
following applies:
Services should be used in line with the Apple Store and/or Google Play Terms of Service, including any associated
terms such as the Google Play Business and Program Policies or such other terms designated as default end-user
license terms by any Third-Party Beneficiary.
The Parties acknowledge that Third-Party Beneficiaries have no obligation to furnish any maintenance or support service
with respect to Services.

The Parties acknowledge that Third-Party Beneficiaries bear no responsibility for any claims that the use of Services
infringes the intellectual property rights of third parties.
The Parties acknowledge that Third-Party Beneficiaries bear no responsibility or liability related to compliance or
non-compliance by Showbie or You (or any other user) under these Terms or the Third-Party Beneficiary’s respective
terms.The Parties acknowledge and agree that Third-Party Beneficiaries are beneficiaries of these Terms and will have
the right (and will be deemed to have accepted the right) to enforce the Terms against You.
3.0 User Content
